meta.description: How Better Life Moving collects, uses and protects the information you share through this website, forms, phone calls and text messages.

overview: This Privacy Policy describes how Better Life Moving ("we," "us," or "our") collects, uses, and discloses your information when you use our website (the "Website"), social media pages, or other online services (collectively, the "Services") and explains your privacy rights and how the law protects you. We also explain how we comply with RingCentral's SMS/MMS content policy requirements for sending text messages.

list: We will not send you any SMS messages unless you have given us your express prior written consent. This means you must actively opt-in to receive text messages from us.

We will use various methods to obtain your consent, such as through a checkbox on our website form that clearly states you are opting in to receive SMS messages, or by having you send a confirmation text message to a designated number.
We will record and track all opt-ins and opt-outs.
You have the right to opt-out of receiving SMS messages from us at any time. You can do this by replying to any text message you receive from us with the keyword "STOP" or "UNSUBSCRIBE".
We will clearly state instructions for opting out in all SMS messages we send.
We collect information you provide directly when you use the Services, such as your name, email address, phone number, and the details of your moving request.
We may also collect information automatically through your use of the Services, such as your IP address, device type, and browsing activity.
We use your information to provide and improve the Services, process your requests, send you appointment reminders and updates.
We will not share your information with any third party for marketing purposes without your express consent.
We may disclose your information if required by law or to protect the rights or safety of ourselves or others.
We take reasonable steps to protect your information from unauthorized access, disclosure, alteration, or destruction.
However, no internet transmission or electronic storage method is completely secure, so we cannot guarantee the absolute security of your information.

body: Our Services are not directed to children under 13. We do not knowingly collect personal information from children under 13. If you are a parent or guardian, and you are aware that your child has provided us with personal information, please contact us. If we become aware that we have collected personal information from anyone under 13 without verification of parental consent, we take steps to remove that information from our servers.

Better Life Moving collects both personal and non-personal information to enhance the user experience and provide effective services. Personal data includes details you provide directly, such as your name, email, and phone number, while non-personal data encompasses information gathered automatically, like your IP address and browsing activity.

This data collection allows us to process your requests efficiently, send you updates, and improve our services. For instance, understanding user behavior through browsing patterns helps us tailor our offerings, ensuring that you receive relevant information and timely notifications regarding your moving services.

The information collected by Better Life Moving is primarily used to deliver and enhance our services. This includes processing your moving requests, sending appointment reminders, and communicating updates about your service. We may also use your data for marketing purposes, but only with your explicit consent.

Data utilization extends to improving our website's functionality and user experience. For example, analyzing how users interact with our services helps us identify areas for improvement, ensuring that our website remains user-friendly and efficient in providing the necessary information about our moving services.

Better Life Moving is committed to protecting your privacy and will only share your personal information in specific circumstances. This includes instances where we are legally required to do so or if we need to share your information with trusted service providers who assist us in delivering our services.

We ensure that any third parties with whom we share your information adhere to strict confidentiality agreements. For example, if we collaborate with a payment processor, they will only use your information for transaction purposes and will not retain it for any other use, safeguarding your personal data from unauthorized access.

As a user of Better Life Moving's services, you have specific rights regarding your personal information. These rights include the ability to access, correct, or delete your data, as well as the right to withdraw consent for processing your information at any time.

We encourage users to exercise their privacy rights by contacting us directly. For instance, if you wish to opt-out of marketing communications, you can easily do so by following the instructions provided in our emails or by contacting our customer service team for assistance.
We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. We will notify you of any changes by posting the new Privacy Policy on the Website.
If you have any questions about this Privacy Policy, please contact us at [(617) 668-1807](tel:+16176681807) or [betterlifemoving@gmail.com](mailto:betterlifemoving@gmail.com).
**By using our Services and providing your phone number, you agree to the terms of this Privacy Policy.**
